summary_ja: SamsungのFMS 2026発表から、400層超V10 BV-NANDのwafer bondingと、zHBMの縦積層・interlayer IP構想を追加しました。V9比58%密度向上はvendor値、zHBMのHBM5比性能・密度・energy・熱予測はconcept projectionとして扱い、製品・量産・独立実測と分けます。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: From Samsung's FMS 2026 disclosure, this update adds wafer bonding in 400-plus-layer V10 BV-NAND and the zHBM vertical-stack and interlayer-IP concept. The 58% V9 density improvement is a vendor figure, while zHBM performance, density, energy, and thermal comparisons with HBM5 are concept projections separated from products, volume production, and independent measurements. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_en: Samsung bonded V-NAND and vertically stacked memory concepts
sections.summary_ja: FMS 2026の展示を、製造を公表した技術、concept model、将来予測に分けて整理します。
sections.summary_en: Separate FMS 2026 disclosures into announced manufacturing technology, concept models, and future projections.

items.timing_ja: 2026年8月FMSで公開、製品時期は未公表
items.timing_en: Disclosed at FMS in August 2026; product timing not published
items.statement_ja: SamsungはV10 Bonding V-NANDを400層超とし、memory cell層をwafer bondingで積層する構成によりV9比でmemory densityを約58%高めたと公表しました。read、write、I/O、電力も前世代より改善するとしていますが、capacity、interface、latency、throughput、energy、yield、bond pitch、sample・量産時期は本文に定量値がありません。展示した構造modelを出荷製品や量産実績とは扱いません。
items.statement_en: Samsung describes V10 Bonding V-NAND as exceeding 400 layers and using wafer bonding for the memory-cell stack, with about 58% higher memory density than V9. It also claims improved read, write, I/O, and power behavior, but the article gives no numeric capacity, interface, latency, throughput, energy, yield, bond pitch, sampling date, or mass-production date. The displayed structural model is not treated as a shipping product or volume-production evidence.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI storageの容量・電力roadmapではlayer数だけでなく、controller、package、耐久性、error、交換単位、量産yieldを含む製品条件へ落とす必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI storage capacity and power roadmaps must translate layer counts into product conditions covering controllers, packaging, endurance, errors, replacement units, and production yield.
adoption_conditions_ja: sample・量産時期、製品capacity、form factor、interface、DWPD、UBER、保証期間を確認する。
bonding工程を含むyield、thermal cycle、接合欠陥とfailure isolationを公開比較する。
V9と同じworkload・capacity・controllerで性能、energy、費用を測定する。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify sampling and volume dates, product capacity, form factor, interface, DWPD, UBER, and warranty.
Compare yield, thermal cycling, bond defects, and failure isolation including the bonding process.
Measure performance, energy, and cost against V9 with the same workload, capacity, and controller.

items.name_en: zHBM vertical integration and thermal-design boundary
items.statement_ja: zHBMはHBMをAI acceleratorの横ではなく上に積み、interlayerへ顧客固有IPを置く構想です。Samsungは次世代interfaceを含む構成についてHBM5比で性能約8倍、density 10倍超、energy efficiency 3倍、thermal resistance半減超を予測します。比較するsystem境界、積層数、process、冷却、workloadは公表されておらず、相互に独立した実測値でもありません。logicとmemoryを縦積層するほど、短距離配線の利点と熱・yield・修理不能性を同時に評価する必要があります。
items.statement_en: zHBM proposes stacking HBM above rather than beside an AI accelerator and placing customer-specific IP in an interlayer. Samsung projects roughly eight times HBM5 performance for a next-generation-interface configuration, more than ten times density, three times energy efficiency, and over half the thermal resistance. The system boundary, stack count, process, cooling, and workload are not published, and these are not independent measurements. As logic and memory are stacked vertically, shorter interconnects must be evaluated together with thermal, yield, and repairability risks.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 将来nodeを検討する際、package内bandwidthだけでなく、cooling、known-good-die、交換単位、vendor lock-in、software interfaceを同一の採用条件にします。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Future-node evaluation should qualify cooling, known-good-die strategy, replacement granularity, vendor lock-in, and software interfaces alongside in-package bandwidth.
adoption_conditions_ja: HBM5比較のsystem境界、workload、precision、容量、電力、冷却条件を開示する。
junction temperature、thermal gradient、throttling、bond failure、package yieldを測定する。
標準HBM構成とのsoftware互換性と調達・交換単位を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Disclose system boundaries, workloads, precision, capacity, power, and cooling for the HBM5 comparison.
Measure junction temperature, thermal gradients, throttling, bond failures, and package yield.
Verify software compatibility and procurement and replacement granularity against standard HBM systems.
